text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri says the fight against drug trafficking is a top priority.
- Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini to pay a two-day visit to Morocco starting on July 16.
- France's ambassador in Rabat says number of visas delivered to Moroccans could increase to 100,000 in two years from current 60,000.
- Minister Basri said cocaine seized in Morocco could meet the needs of European addicts during two years.
- National Council for Youth and Future holds meeting over results of survey on education and training.
- Health workers to hold third strike in less than a month starting July 22.
- Omar Kabbaj, president of African Development Bank, says Morocco is one of the main recipients of the bank's loans.
